resources.title: Architecture Decisions
resources.content:
Static-first approach chosen for zero operational overhead.

Key decisions:
- JSON flat-file database
- Client-side hash routing
- Code-based access control
- No build step required

resources.title: Research: Typography Systems
resources.content:
Classical typography principles for digital archives:

- Leading: 1.6x for comfortable reading
- Measure: 45-75 characters per line
- Hierarchy: Size, weight, and spacing
- Serif for headings, sans for data
